verdict.rationale: Chargebee's own llms.txt shows the API is versioned: it names 'API v2' as the default surface, which implies more than one version exists. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-pinning behavior. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version-pinning or migration guidance, details on how versions coexist, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The default surface is API v2 with Product Catalo
